title: OrderPlaced
description: A customer placed an order. A fact: it does not become untrue, and it is never compacted away.

orderId.description: Partition key. Stable for the life of the order, which is what makes per-key ordering meaningful.

totalAmount.description: Decimal as a string. A JSON number would be parsed as a double by some consumers and lose cents.

occurredAt.description: When the fact became true in the domain, not when it was published.
